articles.title: Union Minister for Communications launches Tejas Networks' hyper-scalable Data Center Interconnect (DCI) platform at Mobile World Congress
articles.summary: Tejas Networks launched its next-generation TJ1600-D3, a versatile WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) system. This advanced technology is vital for optimizing high-capacity data transmission over optical fiber networks. Such innovations significantly enhance India's digital communication infrastructure, supporting national development, critical sectors, and potentially robust command-and-control systems, aligning with 'Digital India' initiatives for a stronger nation.

articles.title: Oil Jumps Again as US Escort Plan for Hormuz Fails to Bring Calm
articles.summary: Oil prices rose due to new attacks in the Middle East, intensifying regional instability. This rise is also influenced by a US plan to insure and escort tankers through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. The US initiative aims to secure global oil supply lines and ensure safe passage through this critical waterway, highlighting maritime security challenges.

articles.title: US, Israel Vow No Letup And 'A Lot Of Hurt' As Campaign Against Iran Intensifies
articles.summary: US President Trump announced "big-scale hitting" against Iran after Iranian defensive assets were reportedly destroyed. A US commander confirmed an initial attack on Iran, signaling a significant military escalation. This points to an intensifying international conflict between the US and Iran, underscoring critical geopolitical developments and global security impacts.
